Apam a ɛyɛ no Ntamgyinafoɔ
1 # Heb 4.14 Na nsɛm a yɛreka yi mu titire nie: Yɛwɔ saa ɔsɔfo panin a wakɔtena tumi kɛseɛ ahennwa no nifa, ɔsoro 2sɛ kronkronbea ne nokorɛ ntomadan a Awurade no ara, na ɛnyɛ onipa, pameeɛ no mu sɔfoɔ.
3 # Heb 5.1 Na ɔsɔfo panin biara wɔhyɛ no sɛ ɔmfa ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔdeɛ mma, enti ɛsɛ sɛ oyi nso nya biribi a ɔde bɛma. 4Na sɛ ɔwɔ asase so deɛ a, anka ɔnyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ mpo, ɛfiri sɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ ma, sɛdeɛ mmara no teɛ, wɔ hɔ dada. 5#Kol 2.17; Eks 25.40 Wɔn na wɔsom ɔsoro nnoɔma nhwɛsoɔ ne mfonini, te sɛdeɛ asɛm a berɛ a Mose rebɛsiesie ntomadan no, ɛbaa ne nkyɛn a ɛse: Hwɛ, yɛ adeɛ nyinaa sɛdeɛ nsususoɔ a wɔkyerɛɛ wo bepɔ no soɔ no teɛ.
6 # Heb 7.22; 12.24; 2 Ko 3.6 Na afei ne nsa aka asɔfodwuma a ɛkyɛne soɔ, sɛ wayɛ apam a ɛkyɛne soɔ a wɔgyina bɔhyɛ a ɛkyɛne soɔ so hyɛɛ ho mmara no ntamgyinafoɔ.
Apam foforɔ bɔhyɛ
7Na sɛ kane apam no ho nni asɛm a, anka wɔrenhwehwɛ deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu toberɛ. 8#Yer 31.31-34; Heb 10.16-17 Na ɔnunu wɔn sɛ:
Hwɛ, nna bi reba, Awurade na ɔseɛ,
sɛ me ne Israel fie
ne Yuda fie bɛpam apam foforɔ,
9 # Eks 19.5-6 ɛnte sɛ apam a me ne wɔn agyanom pameeɛ
da a mesosɔɔ wɔn nsa meyii wɔn mefirii Misraim asase soɔ no;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn deɛ, wɔantena m’apam mu,
na me nso mannwene wɔn ho, Awurade na ɔseɛ.
10Na yei ne apam a
nna no akyi me ne Israel fie bɛpam no, Awurade na ɔseɛ:
Mede me mmara bɛhyɛ wɔn adwene mu,
na matwerɛ no wɔn akoma mu,
na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn,
na wɔn nso ayɛ me ɔman.
11Na obi renkyerɛkyerɛ ne kuromani,
obi renkyerɛkyerɛ ne nua sɛ: Hunu Awurade!
Na wɔn nyinaa bɛhunu me
afiri wɔn mu akumaa so akɔsi ɔkɛseɛ so.
12Na mɛdom wɔn amumuyɛ ho,
na wɔn bɔne deɛ, merenkae bio.
13 # Rom 10.4 Deɛ ɔka sɛ “foforɔ” yi no, ɔde ayɛ kane deɛ no dada, na deɛ ɛreyɛ dada na ɛretwa mu no, aka kakra na ayera.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na nsɛm a yɛreka yi mu titire nie: Yɛwɔ saa ɔsɔfo panin a wakɔtena tumi kɛseɛ ahennwa no nifa, ɔsoro sɛ kronkronbea ne nokorɛ ntomadan a Awurade no ara, na ɛnyɛ onipa, pameeɛ no mu sɔfoɔ.
Na ɔsɔfo panin biara wɔhyɛ no sɛ ɔmfa ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔdeɛ mma, enti ɛsɛ sɛ oyi nso nya biribi a ɔde bɛma. Na sɛ ɔwɔ asase so deɛ a, anka ɔnyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ mpo, ɛfiri sɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ ma, sɛdeɛ mmara no teɛ, wɔ hɔ dada. Wɔn na wɔsom ɔsoro nnoɔma nhwɛsoɔ ne mfonini, te sɛdeɛ asɛm a berɛ a Mose rebɛsiesie ntomadan no, ɛbaa ne nkyɛn a ɛse: Hwɛ, yɛ adeɛ nyinaa sɛdeɛ nsususoɔ a wɔkyerɛɛ wo bepɔ no soɔ no teɛ.
Na afei ne nsa aka asɔfodwuma a ɛkyɛne soɔ, sɛ wayɛ apam a ɛkyɛne soɔ a wɔgyina bɔhyɛ a ɛkyɛne soɔ so hyɛɛ ho mmara no ntamgyinafoɔ.

Na sɛ kane apam no ho nni asɛm a, anka wɔrenhwehwɛ deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu toberɛ. Na ɔnunu wɔn sɛ:
Hwɛ, nna bi reba, Awurade na ɔseɛ,
sɛ me ne Israel fie
ne Yuda fie bɛpam apam foforɔ,
ɛnte sɛ apam a me ne wɔn agyanom pameeɛ
da a mesosɔɔ wɔn nsa meyii wɔn mefirii Misraim asase soɔ no;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔn deɛ, wɔantena m’apam mu,
na me nso mannwene wɔn ho, Awurade na ɔseɛ.
Na yei ne apam a
nna no akyi me ne Israel fie bɛpam no, Awurade na ɔseɛ:
Mede me mmara bɛhyɛ wɔn adwene mu,
na matwerɛ no wɔn akoma mu,
na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn,
na wɔn nso ayɛ me ɔman.
Na obi renkyerɛkyerɛ ne kuromani,
obi renkyerɛkyerɛ ne nua sɛ: Hunu Awurade!
Na wɔn nyinaa bɛhunu me
afiri wɔn mu akumaa so akɔsi ɔkɛseɛ so.
Na mɛdom wɔn amumuyɛ ho,
na wɔn bɔne deɛ, merenkae bio.
Deɛ ɔka sɛ “foforɔ” yi no, ɔde ayɛ kane deɛ no dada, na deɛ ɛreyɛ dada na ɛretwa mu no, aka kakra na ayera.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
